about: Takes on the review list whose line has since left the game's script, so its key no longer resolves. The listening page (tools/voice/review_page.mjs) shows each with the words it was recorded with, as of the batch's source revision, marked retired and unused. A historical record, not a listener's decision; no audio is changed, made or re-keyed.

retired.retiredBy: RV0047: Nao's fourth orchard banter opens on the bell only if it rang (co.b_nao4)
retired.en: Heard about the bell? Everyone ran to the channel when it rang. Their heads forgot; their feet remembered the way.
